items.title: Sebi appoints auditor to probe Coffee Day Enterprises' fund diversion
items.rss_summary: Markets regulator SEBI has appointed a forensic auditor to assist in a probe into the affairs of Coffee Day Enterprises Ltd, following directions from the Securities Appellate Tribunal (SAT). The SAT had on November 5 directed the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to conduct a fresh, independent and comprehensive investigation into the alleged diversion of Rs 3,535 crore from seven subsidiaries of Coffee Day Enterprises Ltd (CDEL) to Mysore Amalgamated Coffee Estates Ltd (MACEL), an entity linked to the company's promoters. Pursuant to the order dated November 5, 2026 passed by the appellate tribunal, CDEL, in a regulatory filing on Thursday, said "SEBI has, vide its letter dated November 25, 2026, informed the company that CLA Indus Value Consulting has been appointed as the forensic auditor to assist the investigating authority."
